finalText:
**Found it.** `computeTotal` in `src/pricing/engine.js` rounded to 2 decimals after the percent coupon and again after the flat coupon — before converting to the order's currency. That's an extra rounding step the correct math never does.

It only showed up in GBP, CAD, and JPY orders with a percent coupon, since those currencies' conversion rates turn tiny rounding drift into a visible cent. USD and flat-only orders happened to round out even, so most carts looked fine.

Fix: only round once, after conversion, matching what finance expects. All 40 tests pass now (was 30 pass, 10 fail).
